    UXML elements

    This section covers the three UI Builder controls that connect a visual tree to the Key Catalog and Navigation Graph. Popup-specific UXML controls are covered in Popups.

    Element Base control Catalog Purpose
    NavElement VisualElement View Registers a graph-controlled View and owns Show/Hide transitions
    NavButton Button Button Publishes a UI Button address when clicked
    NavToggle Toggle Button Publishes a Toggle address and its bool value

    Namespace

    Add the package namespace to hand-authored UXML:

    <ui:UXML xmlns:ui="UnityEngine.UIElements"
         xmlns:nav="NKStudio.UITKNavigation.Elements">
    <nav:NavElement name="main" view-category="Menu" view-key="Main">
        <nav:NavButton text="Settings"
                       signal-category="Menu" signal-key="OpenSettings" />
        <nav:NavToggle label="Music"
                       toggle-category="Settings" toggle-key="Music" />
    </nav:NavElement>
</ui:UXML>

    UI Builder writes the same attributes when you select addresses from its catalog pickers. Register entries in Tools > UI Navigation > Key Catalog first so the correct View or Button picker can find them.

    Address contract

    An address is the case-sensitive Category/Key pair represented by UIKey. The same address must be used at both ends:

    UXML side Graph side
    NavElement View address On Enter/Exit Show or Hide, or UI View output (Animated start only)
    NavButton Button address (signal-* attributes) UI Button output or UI Button Portal
    NavToggle Toggle address Toggle output or Toggle Portal

    Although NavButton's property and UXML attribute names contain Signal, it uses the Button catalog and UI Button event channel. Do not connect it to a graph Signal output.

    At runtime, a valid NavElement registers when it attaches to a Player-context panel. Graph View commands find that registry entry and call its animated or instant visibility methods. UI Builder previews do not register runtime Views.
